title: Consequence of blending two natures
english: If two natures of different substance have been blended into one mixture, neither one is preserved; instead, both are confused and destroyed.
translator_notes: Copy-text: PG 77; Epistula ad Photium via Khazarzar (Epistula ad Photium presbyterum.pdf).
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No copyrighted English base. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify; skip Pusey-PD / Greystone / Lunn / Hill.
Skip Collectio dictorum florilegium; skip ascriptus De sancta trinitate.
baehrens: PG 77; Epistula ad Photium ep rem early
orientation: Cyril is writing to Photius, a presbyter of Alexandria, and states the consequence of a hypothetical blending of two natures.
